ja.title: PXR・LifeSciBench・AIntibodyの順位は何を示すか
ja.summary: 2026年に公表された三つの順位の主張（OpenADMET PXRチャレンジ、OpenAIのLifeSciBench、AIntibody）を、盲検、公式の順位表、不確かさ、利害、基準の五つの問いで読み比べ、公表された数値から「1位」「最高」の意味の違いを整理する。
ja.seo_title: 創薬AIベンチマークの1位は何を示すか
ja.seo_description: PXR、LifeSciBench、AIntibodyの順位を、盲検、公式成績、不確かさ、利害、比較基準から読む。異なる試験の1位を同じ尺度にしない。

en.title: What first place means in drug-discovery AI benchmarks
en.summary: PXR, LifeSciBench and AIntibody show why ranks, uncertainty, baselines and evaluation independence support different claims about AI performance.
en.seo_title: Reading first-place claims in drug-discovery AI
en.seo_description: PXR, LifeSciBench and AIntibody show why ranks, uncertainty, baselines and evaluation independence support different claims about AI performance.

english.title: Reading "No. 1" claims: PXR challenge, LifeSciBench and AIntibody
english.summary: A Japanese note that reads three 2026 ranking claims side by side with five questions (blinding, official leaderboard, uncertainty, conflict of interest, baselines) and shows from published figures how different "first place" can mean.
